subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): honor deadline and skip supplement exhaustive fallback

question: Should `memory_search` prefer returning digest-routed or partial wiki results within its fixed deadline, even when that means dropping the existing full-vault body fallback for supplement searches?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but accepting reduced body-only recall for deterministic deadline behavior is an intentional compatibility tradeoff that repository automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Prefer deadline reliability
options.body: Merge this PR so supplement searches stop full-vault parsing and return digest-routed or partial results within the tool budget.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive recall
options.body: Pause this PR and require an indexed or cached fallback that retains body-only recall without exceeding the memory tool deadline.

recommendation.title: Prefer deadline reliability
recommendation.body: Merge this PR so supplement searches stop full-vault parsing and return digest-routed or partial results within the tool budget.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is most directly connected by history to the digest selection and exhaustive fallback behavior whose product tradeoff is being changed.
